scope.description: Participant eligibility in the per-request VerifyLeader quorum tally, with an unchanged mixed voter/nonvoter configuration and no concurrent leadership/configuration transition during the measured accounting step.
assumptions: Correct peer identities and suffrage; non-Byzantine, well-formed acknowledgments.
An active verification request with initial self support and a configured voter-majority threshold.
excluded: Whether another leader is actually elected.
Membership changes during verification, transport impersonation and restart recovery.
A guarantee that a permitted voter acknowledgment necessarily completes verification.

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: NewRaft skipStartup prevents autonomous main/FSM/snapshot loops. Driver calls actual runFollower and runCandidate for the selected leader; follower RPC pumps dispatch actual processRPC calls without running their election timers.

Driver invokes setupLeaderState/startStopReplication/dispatchLogs and the sourced leaderLoop commit effects (setCommitIndex, setCommittedConfiguration, processLogs) after observing actual majority commitment. It directly invokes verifyLeader as the source main-loop branch does.

A Transport wrapper delays AppendEntries at the send/return boundary. Responses are generated by actual follower handlers through InmemTransport; no reply value is invented. Pipeline support is declined using the supported ErrPipelineReplicationNotSupported path.

Main-loop lease/timer scheduling and FSM consumption are not exercised during the measured step. No external VerifyLeader future success, stale read, competing leader, or full public-API history is inferred.

Private fields are read under their existing locks where concurrent mutation exists. The driver closes replication stop channels, releases blocked transport calls with cancellation, and waits on Shutdown futures.

plan_uncertainties: This check isolates a local eligibility duty. It does not execute the public VerifyLeader return branch, main-loop lease checks, a competing leader election, FSM read, or asynchronous timer consequence.

The heartbeat request may have been sent before registration; response delivery and notification occur after registration, as permitted by the actual notify-map mechanism. The obligation does not assert new-request freshness.
